name: Valeria Quispe Vargas
bio:
Valeria's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the engineering workshops of Lima. After excelling in mechanical engineering, she took a position at a local rally team, quickly rising through the ranks due to her sharp technical mind and proactive problem-solving skills. She transitioned to Porsche Penske Motorsport five years ago as head of vehicle dynamics, proving instrumental in refining their car setups and leading to significant performance improvements. 

As Team Principal, Valeria emphasizes data-driven decisions, fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. Her detail-oriented approach ensures that no stone is left unturned in the pursuit of optimal performance. She believes in a flexible strategy, adapting to the ever-changing dynamics of the race, and her calm demeanor under pressure makes her a natural leader.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Valeria has a serious, focused look, complemented by a warm and welcoming smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and race notes.
Has a peculiar habit of chewing on the end of her pen when deep in thought.
Starts every race day with a cup of mate de coca, believing it helps with focus.
